newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: No rights issue for Winkelhaak expansion.
newsitem.headline: No rights issue for Winkelhaak expansion.

text.p: Gengold Ltd said on Monday that its Evander Gold Mines Ltd unit could exploit ore below existing infrastructure at Winkelhaak No 6 shaft without recourse to a rights issue.

Gengold said in a statement accompanying first quarter results that the three million ounces of recoverable resources below the existing mine would be accessed using horizontal development from No 5 shaft on 22 level and possibly from No 2 shaft on 25 level.
"The development will be combined with the highly successful decline concept which has been proven at Kinross," the company said.

Development on 22 level would cost 20 million rand during the 1998 financial year and the total cost of exploiting this reef would be a fraction of the 600 million rand associated with vertical shaft infrastructure, Gengold said.
